requirement: Official name, address or coordinates, and whether it is the bus shelter, railway station, or one of the two real-venue applications. Identify two named real venues with different climates or systems. State explicitly if a venue serves more than one role.
requested_evidence: Transport operator, site records, official maps

requirement: Which systems are actually installed, their make/model, location, quantity and current use. Clearly distinguish them from equipment proposed only for comparison.
requested_evidence: Operator records, site inspection, equipment labels

requirement: Dates, daily start/end times, timezone, and whether the study covers a particular hot period, season or operating schedule.
requested_evidence: Project brief, operating timetable, available observation records

requirement: Dimensioned plan showing covered/uncovered waiting areas, seats, queues, walls, roof, entrances, exits, openings, equipment and nearby obstructions.
requested_evidence: Survey, architectural drawings, site measurements

requirement: Boundaries of areas with different exposure, shading, ventilation or passenger use. Explain why they should be distinguished.
requested_evidence: Site inspection plus measured spatial differences

requirement: Length, width and effective height of the air region being modeled. For irregular or open areas, provide the geometry and boundary definition rather than guessing a volume.
requested_evidence: Drawings or measured dimensions; analyst documents calculation

requirement: Which zones are shaded, by what structure, and how the shade changes during the study hours. Record any changes to the shade arrangement between comparisons.
requested_evidence: Site survey, time-stamped observations, building geometry

requirement: Weather observations or documented local climate information relevant to the study period, with station location and applicability to the venue.
original_checklist_unit: Source, location, dates and measured climate variables
requested_evidence: Applicable weather station or local observations

requirement: A drawing and explanation of features added in the more detailed station model: extra zones, entrances, surfaces, sources or circulation paths. Supply the same station and conditions for the simpler and more detailed comparisons.
original_checklist_unit: Before/after plans and list of physical changes
requested_evidence: Station drawings, site records, agreed modeling plan

requirement: Dry-bulb air temperature near the venue, measurement location, height and time. Record instrument exposure so direct solar heating of the sensor is not confused with air temperature.
requested_evidence: Suitable local temperature sensor or applicable weather record

requirement: Relative humidity measured at the same place/time as outdoor temperature.
requested_evidence: Humidity sensor or applicable weather record

requirement: Air pressure applicable to the venue and observation time. Identify whether a weather source reports station pressure or sea-level-adjusted pressure; retain that distinction for the analyst.
original_checklist_unit: Pa, or original unit with its label
requested_evidence: Barometer or documented weather source

requirement: Initial temperature at the beginning of the study and time-stamped temperatures during the study. Preserve sensor location.
requested_evidence: Zone temperature sensors

requirement: Initial and time-stamped relative humidity, paired with temperature and pressure. The analyst can calculate water content per kilogram of dry air from these measurements.
requested_evidence: Zone humidity sensors and paired weather records

requirement: Where air comes from and goes to: outdoors, another zone, or a device; include supply, return and exhaust paths. Identify recirculated air separately from fresh outdoor air.
requested_evidence: Ventilation drawings, equipment inspection, airflow survey

requirement: Flow rate and direction at each operating condition/time, including changes when equipment is switched on. If only velocity is measured, also record the opening area and measurement positions needed for a defensible flow calculation.
original_checklist_unit: Prefer original m³/s or m³/h; retain any measured kg/s
requested_evidence: Airflow measurements, applicable fan/duct performance records

requirement: Temperature, humidity and pressure associated with measured volumetric airflow, so the analyst can convert it to total-air and dry-air mass flow.
requested_evidence: Measurements at the relevant inlet, outlet or path

requirement: Dimensions of doors/openings, whether they are open or closed, and changes during the observation period. Geometry alone is not a measured airflow rate.
original_checklist_unit: m or m²; time-stamped open/closed state
requested_evidence: Drawings and site observation

original_quantity: Surfaces exchanging heat with each zone
requirement: Identify each relevant roof, wall, floor or other surface and the area exposed to the zone air.
requested_evidence: Drawings or measurements

requirement: Temperature of each relevant surface over the study intervals, not just outdoor or zone air temperature.
requested_evidence: Applicable contact or infrared measurements with method recorded

requirement: Applicable convective heat-transfer coefficient for each modeled surface, or the geometry, airflow and evidence an analyst needs to select an applicable engineering relation. Do not invent a coefficient.
original_checklist_unit: W/(m²·K), if established; otherwise supporting measurements
requested_evidence: Applicable engineering source or documented calculation

requirement: Heat entering zone air from lighting, motors, electronics, other equipment or processes. Record location, timing and whether stated power is heat released into this zone or merely electrical input.
requested_evidence: Metering, equipment specifications, documented heat accounting

requirement: Water vapor added inside each zone by sources other than the evaporative supply stream; identify source and timing. Avoid counting the cooler's supply moisture twice.
original_checklist_unit: kg of water/s, or observations allowing a documented conversion
requested_evidence: Process measurements, applicable source records

requirement: If walls, roof, floor or furnishings are to store heat in the model: material identity, amount/mass, specific heat, relevant initial temperature and evidence that the material participates over the study period.
original_checklist_unit: kg, J/(kg·K), °C; or documented effective J/K
requested_evidence: Construction records and applicable material data; analyst determines applicability

requirement: A/B/C classification, manufacturer/model if a real product is used, number installed and number running in each interval.
requested_evidence: Equipment labels, operator inventory, operating log

requirement: Position, discharge direction, distance to waiting passengers and any obstructions.
requested_evidence: Site survey or proposed installation plan

requirement: On/off periods, speed or mode, and the rule determining when those settings are used.
requested_evidence: Operator records or explicitly proposed operating plan

requirement: Applicable power at each setting and, if measured, energy over an interval. Preserve the problem-stated powers separately from product-specific measurements.
requested_evidence: Power meter, applicable product specification, supplied problem statement

requirement: Airspeed at the actual occupied positions and relevant body heights, for fan off and each proposed fan setting. Record the locations and the area actually reached.
original_checklist_unit: m/s with position and height in m
requested_evidence: Local airspeed measurements or verified applicable performance measurements

requirement: Supply flow for each operating setting and where that supply enters the occupied space.
original_checklist_unit: m³/s or m³/h, plus air conditions
requested_evidence: Applicable product performance data or measured outlet flow

requirement: Temperature, relative humidity and pressure at the inlet, matched to the outlet measurements and operating setting.
requested_evidence: Paired inlet measurements or an applicable performance test

requirement: Temperature and humidity at the outlet, measured at the same time/setting as the inlet.
requested_evidence: Paired outlet measurements or an applicable performance test

original_quantity: Meaning of the advertised maximum reduction
requirement: Evidence stating whether 5°C/8°C refers to inlet-to-outlet air reduction or a reduction in the shelter, and exactly where/how it was measured.
requested_evidence: Original specification, test report or clarification from the problem source

requirement: Inlet temperature, humidity and pressure; airflow, operating setting, and relevant test geometry at which the stated reduction was achieved.
original_checklist_unit: °C, % RH, Pa, flow units, geometry and mode
requested_evidence: The same reference test that supports the rating

requirement: Verified fraction of the available dry-bulb-to-wet-bulb cooling achieved, or the paired inlet/outlet data needed to calculate it. This is not the electrical efficiency.
requested_evidence: Applicable performance test; analyst derives from documented measurements

requirement: Water actually evaporated over an operating period, if separately measured; otherwise provide matched airflow and inlet/outlet humidity for calculation.
original_checklist_unit: kg or litres with duration; retain temperature if converting volume to mass
requested_evidence: Water balance measurements or paired air measurements

original_quantity: Bleed, drift and other water losses
requirement: Water discharged to control mineral buildup, droplets carried away, or other non-evaporative losses. Identify whether the available water reading includes these losses.
original_checklist_unit: kg or litres per measured duration
requested_evidence: Water-meter logs, operating manual, maintenance records

requirement: Which zones or passenger positions receive the device's effect at each setting, with supporting local airspeed/temperature/humidity measurements.
original_checklist_unit: Labelled area in m² and exposure measurements
requested_evidence: Spatial measurement survey, applicable performance study

requirement: Number of people physically present during each interval, separated into groups only where exposure, clothing or activity differs. Counts of arrivals alone are not occupancy.
requested_evidence: Direct counts, suitable occupancy records

requirement: Arrival/departure or dwell-time evidence sufficient to determine how long people are exposed. Distinguish repeated observations from unique people.
requested_evidence: Passenger survey or applicable operator observations

requirement: If movement is modeled, record when/how people move between zones. Do not change occupancy across options simply to make one device look better.
requested_evidence: Observations or explicitly documented behavior model

requirement: What passengers are doing—sitting, standing, walking, carrying loads—and the duration of each activity. The analyst must source an applicable metabolic rate.
original_checklist_unit: Activity description and duration; metabolic rate in met if justified
requested_evidence: Observations and applicable physiological reference

requirement: Clothing ensembles and relevant differences between groups or periods. The analyst must source an applicable insulation value.
requested_evidence: Observations/survey and applicable clothing reference

requirement: Whether the representative exposure is seated or standing.
requested_evidence: Observation

requirement: Airspeed at occupied positions for each option, including no active cooling; do not substitute total ventilation flow.
requested_evidence: Local airspeed measurements

requirement: The effective radiant temperature seen by a person at each position. Provide a suitable radiant measurement or the raw globe/surface/geometry measurements and method needed to calculate it. Air temperature alone is insufficient.
requested_evidence: Radiant/globe measurements with supporting airspeed and instrument details, or documented radiation calculation

requirement: Fluctuation of local air velocity around its mean, or a time-resolved measurement record from which an analyst can determine the turbulence intensity.
requested_evidence: Suitable airspeed measurement record

original_quantity: Heat and moisture released by occupants
requirement: Applicable sensible heat and water-vapor generation for the observed activity/group, identifying whether values are per person or totals.
original_checklist_unit: W/person and kg/s/person, or clearly labelled totals
requested_evidence: Applicable source data or measurements, with activity and conditions documented

requirement: Description of the population to which the comfort calculation is meant to apply, including any relevant limitations for vulnerable groups.
requested_evidence: Study scope, operator information, appropriate population evidence

requirement: Height and mass appropriate to the explicitly selected population representation, or an approved model-reference population. Do not silently adopt package defaults or seek identifiable personal records unnecessarily.
original_checklist_unit: cm and kg; surface area in m² if documented/derived
requested_evidence: Approved population/model reference or appropriate study data

requirement: Whether the represented activity performs external mechanical work, with an applicable value or a supported zero.
original_checklist_unit: met if established, otherwise activity evidence
requested_evidence: Applicable activity/physiology reference

requirement: Total equipment purchase cost for each venue/option, with quantity and quote date.
requested_evidence: Supplier quotation, procurement records

requirement: Electrical work, plumbing, mounting, site preparation and other installation charges, identifying what is included.
requested_evidence: Installer quotation, operator project records

requirement: Servicing, cleaning, replacement pads/filters, labor and other recurring maintenance, without double counting.
requested_evidence: Maintenance contract, service records

requirement: Supported replacement/service-life period used for annual cost comparison.
requested_evidence: Asset policy, applicable supplier evidence

requirement: Rate the owner wants used to annualize capital costs; specify whether it is zero and the price/inflation basis.
requested_evidence: Project owner or finance policy

requirement: Energy price, dates of applicability and any relevant time-of-use structure.
requested_evidence: Applicable utility bill or tariff

requirement: Whether billed peak demand affects the option; applicable tariff and demand evidence or a justified annual total. State explicitly if not applicable.
original_checklist_unit: Currency/kW and billing period, or justified currency/year
requested_evidence: Utility tariff and metering/billing records

requirement: Applicable water price and billing unit, including any relevant associated charges.
original_checklist_unit: Currency per litre, m³ or kg; identify unit
requested_evidence: Applicable water bill or tariff

requirement: Any other supported annual cost, with description; explicit evidence if none apply.
requested_evidence: Operator/finance records

requirement: Evidence for how often the studied operating conditions occur during a year. A few observed hot hours cannot automatically represent a whole year.
requested_evidence: Timetables, annual weather/occupancy records, documented weighting plan

requirement: Maximum acceptable annualized total cost, and whether separate upfront spending limits also apply.
original_checklist_unit: Currency/year; any separate capital cap labelled
requested_evidence: Project owner

requirement: Maximum electricity use allowed, with the exact time horizon it covers.
requested_evidence: Project owner/operator

requirement: Maximum water consumption allowed, with the exact time horizon it covers.
original_checklist_unit: kg, litres or m³ per stated period
requested_evidence: Project owner/operator

requirement: Upper SET comfort threshold and lower bound for overcooling, supported for the represented population. SET is a calculated comfort index, not simply measured air temperature.
original_checklist_unit: °C SET for both bounds, plus justification
requested_evidence: Agreed project criteria and applicable comfort reference

original_quantity: Minimum acceptable comfort coverage — owner decision
requirement: Required fraction of all occupied time within the agreed comfort bounds. This is a fraction of person-hours, not necessarily the fraction of unique passengers.
requested_evidence: Project owner

requirement: Appropriate heat-stress screening method, thresholds, exposure duration, population applicability and whether passing is mandatory. Do not infer safety from SET alone.
original_checklist_unit: Named method, criteria, units and applicability
requested_evidence: Appropriate qualified assessor and applicable guidance

requirement: Documented assessment of the specified conditions under that rule, including pass/fail, supporting evidence and limitations. If unknown, leave unknown.
requested_evidence: Qualified assessment using actual case conditions

requirement: What is installed in advance; what can be switched or adjusted later; which measurements are available when making those decisions.
requested_evidence: Project owner/operator

requirement: What to do if no device meets comfort/resource/safety requirements or observed conditions lie outside those evaluated; identify whether contingency performance is known.
requested_evidence: Operator and relevant responsible staff

original_quantity: Primary venue for the COO memo
requirement: Which venue the management recommendation should focus on and the intended decision period.
requested_evidence: Project owner

requirement: Actual or explicitly authorized combinations of temperature, humidity and pressure, with timing. Keep combinations physically and empirically supported.
requested_evidence: Venue-relevant observations or documented scenario basis

requirement: Passenger counts by zone and time, waiting duration and group composition for each proposed demand case.
requested_evidence: Observed demand records or explicit planning scenarios

requirement: Lower/upper supported values for comfort thresholds, airflow, local airspeed, area/population served, weather, occupancy and budget/resource limits. Identify the quantity and where/when it applies.
requested_evidence: Measurements, uncertainty estimates, applicable evidence or explicit owner choices

requirement: Which values must change together: for example airflow and fan setting, or occupancy and occupant heat/moisture. Provide the relationship and evidence, not an assumption of independence.
original_checklist_unit: Paired records, performance curves or documented equations
requested_evidence: Same system and applicable operating conditions

requirement: Which two quantities should be varied jointly and which combinations are meaningful.
requested_evidence: Research/owner decision informed by evidence

requirement: Only interpretations of the advertised cooling reductions that have been confirmed as meaningful; supporting reference conditions for each.
requested_evidence: Problem clarification, manufacturer/test report

requirement: Approved ways to divide the same venue, with how people, surfaces, airflow and equipment map between the layouts.
requested_evidence: Site evidence and agreed model design

original_quantity: Monte Carlo uncertainty model — only if requested
requirement: Evidence-based distributions and dependencies, data supporting them, and a clear distinction between uncertain measurements and missing observations.
original_checklist_unit: Joint statistical model and source data
requested_evidence: Qualified statistical/engineering analysis of applicable evidence

requirement: Matching weather, occupancy, shade, device setting, zone temperature/humidity, local airspeed, radiant conditions, electricity and water records. Note unavoidable differences rather than hiding them.
original_checklist_unit: Raw time-stamped records with units and locations
requested_evidence: Check predicted changes against actual observations

requirement: Measurements not already used to calibrate the same model; identify any reuse explicitly.
requested_evidence: Avoid claiming a fit to calibration data is independent validation

requirement: Instrument model, calibration/accuracy information, measurement procedure and known limitations.
original_checklist_unit: Accuracy in each measured unit; calibration record
requested_evidence: Interpret prediction errors and set supported uncertainty ranges

requirement: Inputs, expected outputs, implementation version and source for psychrometric and two-node SET calculations. These are verification cases, not venue observations.
requested_evidence: Check the scientific calculation implementation

requirement: Enough repeated or spatial observations to establish whether zone averages and reported differences are meaningful; retain the available sample count.
requested_evidence: Assess variability and model limitations

requirement: Calculate humidity ratio, wet-bulb temperature, dry-air mass, airflow mass conversions, heat capacitance and evaporative water use from sourced inputs; preserve formulas and provenance.
requested_evidence: Analyst decision and audit

original_quantity: Choose and justify the physical model
requirement: Confirm the well-mixed-zone, heat-capacity, surface, evaporation and moisture-buffering assumptions. Compare response times with weather/occupancy changes before choosing steady or dynamic calculation.
requested_evidence: Analyst decision and audit

requirement: Select an applicable two-node implementation and document all physiological settings, including sweating, vasodilation and vasoconstriction coefficients, exposure duration and represented body surface area. Do not silently inherit defaults.
requested_evidence: Analyst decision and audit

requirement: Set and test numerical tolerances, integration method, time resolution and convergence criteria. Use dimensionally appropriate tolerances; the current shared-tolerance implementation needs review.
requested_evidence: Analyst decision and audit

requirement: State whether regret comparators must be feasible across every scenario or only within the scenario, and justify how near-ties are reported. Apply the same information/resource rules to all options.
requested_evidence: Analyst decision and audit

requirement: Specify grid resolution and combinations; update dependent physical quantities, provenance and alternative zone mappings consistently.
requested_evidence: Analyst decision and audit

requirement: Obtain explicit authorization; implement the supported joint model; choose/document sample count, seed, output quantiles and convergence tests.
requested_evidence: Analyst decision and audit

requirement: Install and audit the required R packages, record versions, test known reference cases and keep separate records of verification, calibration and independent validation.
requested_evidence: Analyst decision and audit

requirement: Add and verify adaptive operating policies, evaporative recirculation or other actual-system features before using them. Complete matched station-revision impact/recovery checks.
requested_evidence: Analyst decision and audit

requirement: Assign consistent venue/zone/equipment/group/scenario labels and retain sources, formulas, units and applicability. Internal code identifiers can be assigned after the information is collected.
requested_evidence: Analyst decision and audit
